historical_non_scoring_tolerance_policy.rationale: Necessary energies share ±.05eV: moderate same-model geometry/integration allowance, small compared with minimum~.77eV separation of T1-vs-high-triplet spacing classes; not current max residual plus epsilon, nor all-high-root certification. f ±.03 addresses figure precision and response variability. No exact CT/NTO, unverified high-root or rate numeric gates. These windows are fixed ex ante to future submissions, not calibrated from historical agent scores, and are not a claim that they predated the archived chemistry runs. Their narrow numerical role is source-observable fidelity after physical comparability is established. Software substitution is allowed; changing method does not create a larger window or a fitted energy offset. A comparable result outside the numeric window can still earn independently evidenced structural, trend and final-inference leaves. Source-model labels specify the physical reference rather than mandate a tool sequence. Round3: source precision and repeated source-route evidence do not establish cross-method fairness. No tolerance was widened to erase an observed residual. Semantic physical-equivalence rules are independent; remaining cross-method numerical calibration is explicitly unresolved.

current_scoring_authority.historical_record_role: All historical, source, numeric-tolerance and prior-acceptance records are non-scoring provenance. Do not restore their thresholds, intermediate inventories or review states. No historical acceptance classification is upgraded.
current_scoring_authority.evidence_requirement: Score only independent final scientific conclusions, totaling 100 points. Require actual executed calculations and recoverable native evidence for the molecular identities, composition, charge/spin, bonding, conditions, physical quantities and reference states relevant to each claim. Numerical energies, geometries and responses are evidence, never author-value targets or tolerance gates. A missing rounded scalar alone does not lose credit when the recoverable calculations establish the requested comparison. Do not restore numerical gates from historical references. Supplied observations, guessed conclusions, copied values, completed jobs, named intermediates and generic limitations earn no independent credit. Accept scientifically established equivalent explanations within the public scope without requiring author software, labels, a fixed intermediate inventory or an additional full reaction network. Method-sensitive alternatives must satisfy the specific criterion and actual evidence; a method change alone does not justify a contradictory claim. Return pass or fail for every item: a supported conclusion receives its whole weight, and an unsupported conclusion receives zero with a specific reason. Record demonstrated reference defects separately in objective_issue_flags; do not fabricate support or erase unrelated valid items. Infrastructure errors must be reported rather than disguised as scientific failures. Whole-case success requires every required_for_success item to pass, while independently supported items retain their points. Historical verification and structural package validation do not confer scientific acceptance. Autonomous research permits independently justified methods; paper reproduction must assess the disclosed author baseline or a scientifically comparable substitution. This comparability obligation does not require exact source numbers or earn process points.

historical_non_scoring_reason: 2026-10-28 final-proposition rewrite with existing native evidence mapped to its actual scope. Contract checks do not establish a new scientific PASS; historical acceptance and unresolved differences remain recorded separately.
historical_non_scoring_evidence_reuse_no: All 12 final vertical energies and four oscillator strengths reuse the four baselines in NATIVE_READBACK.json; unchanged ±0.05 eV and ±0.03 dimensionless windows apply. historical_non_scoring_state_corresponde: Expert attention: the neutral T_edge definition selects the original Ph/Na T4 and An/Py T3 at the source baseline (SI Table S1), but a different model can change that ordering or mix/cross states. Existing evidence does not provide a universal cross-method state correspondence. Never apply a reference window or character target to an unrelated proposed route state, nor silently rematch by root number or nearest target energy. Numeric leaves remain binary with unchanged windows; an unestablished match has no numeric pass, and a demonstrated change of T_edge identity is a reference-applicability issue to record for expert review, not proof that the alternative physical result is wrong. Semantic pathway findings are assessed independently. No claim that AR cross-method fairness or this state-selection ambiguity is fully resolved.
